analysis:
MARKET REGIME: SPY uptrend (+2.4% vs SMA50, +1.27% 20d slope) provides a constructive backdrop, but discipline demands we look at the whole picture before acting.

PORTFOLIO REVIEW: We are running 6 positions at 84% deployment — already ABOVE the 3-5 concentrated position target. Headroom for new buys is only $11,125, which is too small to build a properly sized position at 1-2% equity risk without violating concentration or risk rules. Three positions are underwater: IDXX (-2.42%), LMT (-2.52%), SYK (-1.99%). None have hit stops, and losses are within normal ATR noise, so thesis-break selling is not warranted yet. The three working positions — MCO (+8.04%), AMP (+3.31%), ROP (+2.81%) — should be held. SYK appears on the candidate screener as MIXED/SIDEWAYS with a positive SMA50 slope (+3.6%), so its technical picture is not deteriorating further. IDXX and LMT are not on the candidate list, meaning they are not passing the current quality+trend screen; this warrants closer monitoring but not immediate exits on sub-3% losses.

HISTORICAL PERFORMANCE FLAG: A 25% win rate with a 0.15x profit factor and Sortino of -3.70 is a serious warning. The main culprit is the repeated WDAY entries (three separate stop-outs). The lesson: do not add new positions when the book is already full and the edge data is negative. Cash here is not laziness — it is disciplined risk management.

CANDIDATE SCREEN ASSESSMENT: Several interesting names exist — SCHW (strong SMA50 slope +8.6%, 80% range position — borderline extended), APH (extending, 78% range — avoid), NOC (basing, 18% range but already have LMT in defense), GEHC (basing setup but healthcare already covered via IDXX and SYK). Most high-scoring names are either too extended above SMA50 (PTC +20%, ACN +21%, BR +17%, TYL +18%), in overlapping sectors, or lack the headroom to size properly. No candidate offers a genuinely asymmetric setup that clears all hurdles simultaneously: quality + basing entry + sector diversification + available capacity.

CONCLUSION: Correct action is zero new trades. Preserve the $16K cash cushion. Let the three working positions compound. Monitor IDXX and LMT stops closely. Reassess when positions close and cash increases, or when a candidate offers a cleaner entry.
